mistake_reason: At step 9, FileSurfer withheld critical raw Source cell content (verbatim author/year and bracketed [Ref #] tokens) and instead provided normalized, high-level descriptors. This concealed that table #5 duplicated the source for table #1 (which bore an explicit indicator pointing to the same reference number) and hid exact reference cues present in the file. The omission led the team to assume #5 was a distinct Turkey retail follow-up and assign it to Ref 12 rather than correctly mapping it to Ref 8. This is an FM-2.4 Information Withholding error: the agent failed to share precise data it possessed, directly impacting downstream decision-making and causing the wrong final mapping.
